seo.description: Practical reading for before, during and after a visit: what to bring, how video consultations work and how to help someone else book their care.

intro.title: Good to know before you go.
intro.lead: Practical reading for before, during and after an example visit. None of this is medical advice.

items.title: In person at the clinic
items.copy: Our example clinics have step-free entrances. Contact the team to discuss your access needs before your visit.

items.title: Video consultations
items.copy: Choose video in the visit selector to explore example video availability. You will need a suitable device and a private place to talk.

items.title: What to bring
items.copy: Have a list of questions and relevant appointment documents ready. Ask the clinic about payment or coverage before your visit.

next.eyebrow: Your next step, at your pace
next.heading: Ready when you are.
next.copy: Choose a clinician, pick a time, and review the details before you confirm.

notice.title: Example reading only
notice.copy: These guides are illustrative examples written for a design demonstration. They are not medical advice and no real care is provided through this site.
